verdict.rationale: Vercel offers building blocks for alerting — a Slack marketplace integration for deployment status/comment notifications (vercel-intdir-6), webhooks that fire on deployment events like errors/failures (vercel-supp-webhooks), and framework-aware monitoring of traffic/errors (vercel-docs-30) — but there is no documented native alerting feature where a devops-lead defines custom conditions (e.g., error-rate thresholds) and Vercel sends email/chat notifications directly; achieving that requires wiring webhooks to a third-party notifier or using the Better Stack/Slack integrations. Missing for 10: a first-party condition-based alert rule builder, documented email notification channel for custom thresholds, and evidence of configurable alert conditions beyond deployment status events.
